items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Chuck Flores on drums and oh, it was a fantastic date.

ctx.x: Yeah, my quintet. I was trying to think of who was in the band at the Hague. That was a good album.

Then I made another album out here called -- one tune was on there called "Keyster Parade". It was Conrad Gozzo Richard Kamuca , Chuck Flores on drums and oh, it was a fantastic date. The bass trumpet player in Chicago, he wrote all the arrangements.
